snippet.title: 🍕 Pizzaïolo Ninja - The Die & Retry That Hurts Your Ego! 🍕
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam NOW! ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076150/PizzaoloNinja/

🎮 ABOUT THE GAME:

Dive into the frantic and hilarious adventure of Tony Tribbiani, a 100% furious pizza-chef ninja! In this unique platformer die & retry game, you climb the evil Bartony's tower to save your uncle's pizzeria from being replaced  a disgusting industrial pineapple pizza dispenser.

KEY FEATURES:
• 100 diabolical levels filled with unique traps (slippery platforms, pineapple jets, olive oil barrels, and pigeons?!).
• A global speedrun leaderboard to challenge the best players in the world.
• A unique Twitch Streamer Mode: Your chat can help or trick you with interactive quizzes!
• Falls commentated in real-time by the game's creator (suffering has never been this fun).
• A wacky story, crazy NPCs, and hidden easter eggs everywhere.
• You don't die... but you fall from very, very high!
• High quality voice acting by Bob Lennon and Roman Dub!

📖 THE STORY:
Bartony, the tyrant of industrial pizza, wants to expand his empire of pineapple pizza dispensers! Play as Tony and use your ninja skills to climb to the top of his tower and save your uncle's traditional pizzeria.
